text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired PD-23456 -> GPU memory pressure detected on pool=gp-eu-2, node=gpu-12, severity=P1. metric=nvml_free_bytes < 160MB for 30s. potential OOMs and 5xxs.

pagerduty: Alert PD-23456 acknowledged by maria (on-call)

maria: acked. I'm looking now. Paging kevin for runtime help. Can someone check customer impact?

kevin: on it — pulling nvml logs and check recent deploys. tagging @alex for routing rules.

alex: seeing a burst of long sequences from customer svc-team-a hitting the large-model queue. autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough. temp mitigation: shift traffic to maglev-fallback model (smaller) and set per-node max_concurrency=1.

sophie: customer-facing: svc-team-a reports ~30% 503s in last 2 min, users stuck on streaming responses. Notified support to message customers.

kevin: nvml snippet: `NVMLError: cuMemAlloc failed  out of memory` and kernel logs show `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` on gpu-12. also kv-cache accounted 1.9GB per instance.

maria: runbook step: drain node gpu-12 and evacuate active tasks, then restart infer-worker. kevin please kick off drain. Command: `./infra drain-node gpu-12 --force --grace 30s`

kevin: running drain now. hooking in live tail: ```drain-node: starting eviction (4 tasks) evicting task 3/4 -> reroute to gp-eu-1```

alex: pushed temporary routing rule: route model=redwood/rw-large-* -> fallback=rw-medium-1 for pool gp-eu-2 until 3487654621. Also lowered batch_size from 64->16 for large models on gp-eu-1 to reduce mem.

sophie: support update sent: "We're mitigating a GPU memory surge causing intermittent 503s for long-sequence workloads. Engineers are draining the affected node and routing traffic to smaller model variants. ETA 5-10m." :hourglass:

maria: drain complete, node shows freed memory, restarting worker process: `systemctl restart infer-worker@gpu-12`

kevin: restart logs: `infer-worker: startup ok, nvml free=4.7GB`. No new OOMs on gpu-12. Monitoring for 10m.

incident-bot: PD-23456 -> status changed to "Mitigated" by maria.

maria: handing off to kevin for postmortem and follow-up. will mark as resolved after 20m stable. For postmortem: capture seq lengths, client tokens, autoscaler latency, and model kv-cache sizes.

alex: will open an ops task to add an early-shedder for sequences > 32k and tune autoscaler warmup.

kevin: noted. adding tags: `pd:23456`, `customer:svc-team-a`, `impact:503s`, `cause:gpu-mem-surge`

sophie: thanks team. I'll keep customers updated until resolved. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PD-23456 status -> acknowledged -> mitigated -> awaiting resolution window.
